title: Princeton Bancorp Announces YTD & Fourth Quarter 2025 Results
summary: Princeton Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ - BPRN), the bank holding company for The Bank of Princeton (the “Bank”), today reported its unaudited financial condition at, and its results of operations for the quarter and twelve-months ended, December 31, 2025. President/CEO Edward Dietzler commented on the quarter results, “The Bank achieved another strong quarter, with net income of $6.1 million and diluted EPS of $0.90. These results were supported by an increase in non-interest income of over 11%, as well as a reduction in operating expenses of 8.5%, in each case compared to the third quarter of this year.
